cost_gate.action_rule: Do not upgrade unless expected swing edge exceeds both cost and minimum edge gates.

cost_gate.market_regime_rule: Do not upgrade when the market proxy is above the action range limit.
cost_gate.market_specific_risk_rule: Do not upgrade when deterministic HK/A-share quote, halt, or limit-board gates are blocked.
cost_gate.nontechnical_evidence_rule: Do not upgrade when required fundamentals, valuation, catalyst, flow, macro, and event-risk evidence is missing, stale, or below threshold.
cost_gate.symbol_adverse_rule: Do not upgrade symbols with a recent adverse-breach risk tag; keep them watch-only until evidence improves.
